text.div:
Generated Narrative: OperationDefinition append-retina-ai-result

URL: [base]/DiagnosticReport/[id]/$append-retina-ai-result

Parameters

UseNameScopeCardinalityTypeBindingDocumentation
INsectraStudyId1..1Identifier

Sectra study identifier for the retinal images that were analyzed. System: http://dips.no/fhir/RetinaIntegration/sectra-image-study-id

INconclusion1..1CodeableConcept

Conclusion code for the AI analysis, added to DiagnosticReport.conclusionCode. MUST use codes from RetinaDiagnosticReportConclusionCodeValueSet (http://dips.no/fhir/RetinaIntegration/ValueSet/retina-diagnosticreport-conclusioncode-vs)

INdaysUntilNextExamination0..1integer

Number of days until next examination, stored in extension http://dips.no/fhir/StructureDefinition/days-until-next-examination-extension

INaiDevice1..1Device

AI Device that performed the analysis. MUST conform to RetinaAIDevice profile (http://dips.no/fhir/RetinaIntegration/StructureDefinition/retina-ai-device). Should include deviceName with AI product name, and version elements for algorithm version and protocol.

INrightDiabeticRetinopathyFinding0..1Observation

Right eye diabetic retinopathy finding. MUST conform to RetinaDiabeticRetinopathyFinding profile with bodySite set to right eye (SNOMED CT: 5597008).

INrightDiabeticMacularEdemaFinding0..1Observation

Right eye diabetic macular edema finding. MUST conform to RetinaDiabeticMacularEdemaFinding profile with bodySite set to right eye (SNOMED CT: 5597008).

INrightImageQualityAssessment0..1Observation

Right eye image quality assessment. MUST conform to RetinaImageQualityAssessment profile with bodySite set to right eye (SNOMED CT: 5597008).

INleftDiabeticRetinopathyFinding0..1Observation

Left eye diabetic retinopathy finding. MUST conform to RetinaDiabeticRetinopathyFinding profile with bodySite set to left eye (SNOMED CT: 58443009).

INleftDiabeticMacularEdemaFinding0..1Observation

Left eye diabetic macular edema finding. MUST conform to RetinaDiabeticMacularEdemaFinding profile with bodySite set to left eye (SNOMED CT: 58443009).

INleftImageQualityAssessment0..1Observation

Left eye image quality assessment. MUST conform to RetinaImageQualityAssessment profile with bodySite set to left eye (SNOMED CT: 58443009).

INfullReport1..1Attachment

Technical details for further reference about the AI grading, stored in DiagnosticReport.presentedForm

INmetaTags0..*Coding

Workflow tags. Add code http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-ActReason#VALIDATION when data is for validation purposes only and the result from the AI analysis will not be used in clinical decision making.
